## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Chírén púsà jīng* (T481) is a four-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra translated by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Dharmarakṣa (Zhú Fǎhù). The protagonist's name *Chírén* 持人 ("Person-Holder") translates Sanskrit *Lokadharma* or possibly *Sattvadhāraka*. The Taishō header cross-references No. 482 — [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva's *Chíshì jīng* 持世經 ([KR6i0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0111)), which is a translation of the same Indic text.

**Abstract**

This text and [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva's later *Chíshì jīng* [KR6i0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0111) (T482) are translations of the same Indic *Lokadhara-paripṛcchā-sūtra*. The doctrinal content concerns the bodhisattva's *vyūha-kṣetra* (array-field) — the way a bodhisattva supports beings through wisdom and merit. The text is doctrinally close to the *Aṣṭasāhasrikā* and other early *prajñāpāramitā* literature.

Translation dated to Dharmarakṣa's productive period (266–308 CE).
